dpia_risks_scale_ck.name: dpia_risks_scale_ck
dpia_risks_scale_ck.value:
"dpia_risks"."likelihood" BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND "dpia_risks"."impact" BETWEEN 1 AND 5
          AND ("dpia_risks"."residual_likelihood" IS NULL OR "dpia_risks"."residual_likelihood" BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
          AND ("dpia_risks"."residual_impact" IS NULL OR "dpia_risks"."residual_impact" BETWEEN 1 AND 5)

dpias_period_ck.name: dpias_period_ck
dpias_period_ck.value: "dpias"."period_start" IS NULL OR "dpias"."period_end" IS NULL OR "dpias"."period_start" <= "dpias"."period_end"

remediation_tasks_subject_ck.name: remediation_tasks_subject_ck
remediation_tasks_subject_ck.value: ("remediation_tasks"."source" IN ('finding', 'manual')) OR ("remediation_tasks"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL AND "remediation_tasks"."gap_code" IS NOT NULL)
